title: Transmission Impairment: Attenuation, Distortion, Noise
keyPoints: What is sent is not what is received: attenuation, distortion, noise (slide 61).
dB = 10 log10(P2/P1); losses and gains in dB are additive (slides 63–66).
dBm = 10 log10 Pm with Pm in milliwatts (slide 67).
Distortion: components travel at different speeds, causing phase differences (slide 69).
Noise types: thermal, induced, crosstalk, impulse (slide 70).
